headline: Working together
intro: I'm drawn to unposed, candid moments, and to the places, events and buildings where they happen. I like frames that feel found rather than staged. If you have a project in mind and think my work might be a fit, I'd love to hear about it.

services.name: Unposed & candid moments
services.description: Real moments as they unfold, captured without staging or interruption.

services.name: Places & events
services.description: Landscapes, travel and destinations, plus documentary-style coverage of events and gatherings.

services.name: Buildings & architecture
services.description: Exteriors, interiors and details. Clean lines, true verticals and natural light.

services.name: Licensing & custom work
services.description: Existing images for editorial, web or print, or something made for your project.

contactText: Have a question about a project, a photo, licensing or how an image can be used? Send me a note and I'll get back to you.
